voice.name: Open Sector - Rocketer
voice.description: Wiry, hyperactive young male rocket trooper in his mid twenties, slightly raspy tenor voice with a fast-talking big-city street accent, cocky show-off energy, loves explosions, talks quickly with excited laughs, a bit reckless and very proud of his launcher.
voice.sample: Rocketer here, tube's hot and I got plenty on my back! You point, I make it go boom, simple as that. And the big one? The guided one? Oh, that's special. That one you gotta ask nice for.

fire.prompt: A World War 2 anti-tank rocket launcher firing in an open field: a violent roaring backblast and a rocket screaming away into the distance.

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt with rocket tubes and metal launcher rattling on his back, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: A heavy guided missile launching on a World War 2 battlefield: a sharp ignition bang and a long fierce roar as it streaks away into the distance.

reload.prompt: Rocket pulled from a back rack and slid into a metal launcher tube, metallic scrape and latch click, close up, no music, no voice
